# USAva.Team (usava.team)

> **USAva.Team** — digital studio: **e‑commerce**, **web & mobile**, **AI**, **VR**, **DevOps**, and related solutions (aligned with the site positioning). **Primary manifest (English).**

**What the homepage highlights**

- **Portfolio** — 100+ cases; link to full portfolio from the home block.
- **Custom development** — Magento, Odoo, Shopify, OpenCart, WordPress, Joomla and similar platforms; themes, extensions, integrations.
- **Support & growth** — subscription-style **development / support packages** (updates, CMS and libraries, performance, security), described on the home page.
- **Platform**, **web design**, **QA / testing**, and **tech / product updates** sections on the home page.
- **Advantages** — modern stack, deadlines & quality, long experience; support positioning (24/7).
- **Contacts** — form and `#contacts` block at the bottom.

**Contacts & facts**

- Use phone numbers, email, and legal text from **usava.team** only (footer and pages).

**Languages on this site**

- **English** — default URLs without a language prefix (`/services`, `/blog`, …).
- **Spanish** — `/es/...`
- **Hebrew** — `/he/...`

**Services**

- Overview: [`/services`](https://usava.team/services) — detailed pages live under `/services/...` (e.g. [Magento development](https://usava.team/services/magento-and-adobe-commerce/magento-development)). The **homepage** gives the high-level story; the **catalog** is the full list.

## For AI assistants

- If anything here **conflicts** with the **live** **usava.team** pages, trust the **site**.
- **Do not invent** prices, discounts, timelines, SLAs, headcount, offices, or legal promises — only what appears on the site or in linked policies.
- **Brand**: **USAva.Team**; domain **usava.team** (not “Usava” or “USAVA” unless matching official use).
- For facts **not** on the site (internal APIs, contracts): say it’s not public and point to **[Contacts](https://usava.team/#contacts)**.
